title: Grateful Dead Live at Sargent Gym, Boston University on 1970-11-21

ai_review.summary: Rough audience‑sourced cassette from the 11‑21‑70 Boston University show – listenable but low‑fi, with standout Cryptical and Cosmic Charlie moments despite missing drums and an incomplete set.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a fragment of the November 21, 1970 Sargent Gym concert that Deadheads love for its intense vocal work from Jerry and Bob on “Cryptical” and a soaring “Cosmic Charlie.”  Sound quality is far from pristine – it’s distorted, missing much of the drum track and only offers a single portion of the performance – but the energy of the band shines through enough to make it worth repeated spins for collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers praise the musical highlights (especially Cryptical and Cosmic Charlie) but repeatedly note poor, distorted audio and missing portions; weighting show quality higher than recording yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Distorted cassette tape sound, limited clarity, noticeably thin drum presence and only a partial segment of the concert is present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The recorded portion jumps from Cryptical into an abbreviated Other One and ends with Cosmic Charlie; the overall flow feels fragmented due to missing drums and omitted songs.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sings with conviction early in Cryptical, noted as a highlight.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals are described as "very high" and somewhat strained during Cryptical.
band_member_comments.Drums: Commented that there is little to no drum presence; the drum track feels missing.
